newsitem.title: USA: San Francisco airport panel approves rail project.
newsitem.headline: San Francisco airport panel approves rail project.

text.p: The San Francisco Airport Commission approved a lease agreement on Tuesday clearing the way for a $1.167 billion rail extension project.
The airport commission approved the lease and operating agreement by a vote of 4-to-0, a spokesman said.
The agreement allows the San Francisco Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) District to build rail facilities at the airport for an annual rent of $2.5 million for 50 years.
The vote cleared a hurdle to the $1.167 billion BART rail project. BART is still awaiting the issuance of a federal funding agreement for $750 million.
The 8.7-mile project would extend BART to the San Francisco International Airport.
